messages:
Alex W: Quick update — rolled qv5-int4 to staging 10% yesterday, AB vs stable shows regression on docs-longform and code-gen slices. Sharing numbers.

Mira S: numbers?

Alex W: Docs-longform MRR -1.8% (p<0.01), ROUGE-L -2.1% abs. Code-gen pass@1 -0.4% abs but latency down 18%.

Sam P: interesting — latency headroom is good but quality drop on longform is concerning. What's our rollback rule? current gate: abs_drop>1.5% OR KL > 0.03 triggers rollback.

Joan L: That gate is too tight for very high variance slices. Suggest composite rule: for critical slices (docs-longform) use abs_drop>1.0% and concordance drop >1.0. For others keep 1.5.

Alex W: Concordance (rwd-v5 eval) dropped 1.2 on that slice.

Sam P: propose auto-fallback criteria: (a) abs_drop >=1.5% on top-5 slices OR (b) any slice with concordance delta >=1.0 AND p<0.05 OR (c) KL divergence >0.04. If met, revert promote.

Joan L: Also add hysteresis: require condition to hold for 2 consecutive hours of hourly windows or 2/3 checks.

canary-bot: smokecheck summary — 4805551200: stable vs qv5-int4 @10%: |docs-longform|MRR|-1.8%|p=0.008|concordance|-1.2|

Mira S: Can we add a shadow run for 48h with longer prompts for docs-longform? want to see prefix mismatch.

Alex W: yes. starting shadow at 20% for 48h. Also enabling KV cache bypass to rule out cache artifacts.

Sam P: config snippet for the gate I'm pushing to staging:
```yaml
rollout_gate:
  name: 'composite-canary-thermometer'
  windows: [1h]
  rules:
    - slice: 'docs-longform'
      abs_drop_threshold: 1.0
      concordance_threshold: 1.0
    - global:
      abs_drop_threshold: 1.5
      kl_threshold: 0.04
  hysteresis: {checks_required: 2, window_count: 3}
  auto_fallback: true
```

Joan L: LGTM. add a metric tag for 'cache-bypass' so we can compare.

Alex W: Will do. I'll pause the broader promote until 48h shadow finishes and gate clears. Tracing/links in #eng-platform if anyone needs them.

Mira S: Thanks — keeping an eye. :eyes: 

Sam P: ping me if concordance >1.0 persists after shadow.

canary-bot: action — scheduled shadow at 4805552400 for 48h; alert threshold set per composite-canary-thermometer.
